interview.answer: It’s still pending, but Rey said to head to the tables by the community shed.

reflections: They value concrete logistics before committing to help or attend.
They respond well to clear, timely follow-through on details.
The interaction is cooperative and detail-oriented, with shared expectations around preparation.
Pia consistently needs concrete logistics before committing, so she values clear planning over vague assurances.
Quinn and Dane are helping by gathering and forwarding details, suggesting a collaborative effort to coordinate the repair drive.
